description:
12 real deep sea discoveries, ordered by depth: sharks living inside an erupting volcano near the surface, a lake at the bottom of the sea, oxygen appearing where it shouldn't, and gardens of life 9,533 meters down in the deepest trenches. Doug goes a little deeper each time. Doug did not agree to this.

Which deep-sea discovery should Doug visit next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
